title: Condition-controlled loops
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: Condition-controlled loops
objectives: know how to write a while loop and what makes it stop repeating
understand how a validation loop keeps asking until the value typed in is acceptable
know how a sentinel value ends a loop when the amount of data is not known in advance
starter: A program sets count = 5, then a while loop runs for as long as count > 0, and the only line inside the loop prints count. Describe what happens when this program runs, and write down the one line that is missing.

exam: A validation loop reads a whole number, then repeats for as long as it is outside 1 to 20. When 99 is typed the program prints out of range over and over. State what has been left out of the loop, and where in the loop it belongs.

Write a program that keeps asking for a word until yes or no is typed, printing please answer yes or no for every other word, and then prints the word that was accepted.
